methods_quotes.q: 2020 U.S. Census Bureau data were used as population denominators for incidence calculations.
For the years 2017–2019, illness onset date was used
Data were analyzed using SAS software (version 9.4; SAS Institute).
Incidence is defined as the number of cases per 100,000 population according to 2020 U.S. Census Bureau data.
Subtotal incidence figures reflect median incidence across jurisdictions in each incidence category.
Cases and incidence during 2017–2019 reflect the 3-year annual average.
